description: This file defines a class 'ChannelsCenterView' for automating UI interactions and assertions on the Mattermost channel center view in end-to-end tests using Playwright.

classes.name: ChannelsCenterView
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions and assertions for the channel center view in Playwright E2E tests.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the channel center container and post creation area are visible.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message with optional files in the channel.

methods.name: getFirstPost
methods.description: Retrieves the first post in the channel view.

methods.name: getLastPost
methods.description: Retrieves the last post in the channel view.

methods.name: getLastPostID
methods.description: Gets the ID of the last post.

methods.name: getNthPost
methods.description: Retrieves the Nth post from the top.

methods.name: getPostById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: waitUntilLastPostContains
methods.description: Waits until the last post contains specific text.

methods.name: waitUntilPostWithIdContains
methods.description: Waits until a specific post contains specific text.

methods.name: clickOnLastEditedPost
methods.description: Clicks on the icon of the last edited post.

methods.name: assertChannelBanner
methods.description: Asserts the channel banner's text and background color.

methods.name: assertChannelBannerNotVisible
methods.description: Asserts the channel banner is not visible.

methods.name: assertChannelBannerHasBoldText
methods.description: Asserts the banner contains bold text.

methods.name: assertChannelBannerHasItalicText
methods.description: Asserts the banner contains italic text.

methods.name: assertChannelBannerHasStrikethroughText
methods.description: Asserts the banner contains strikethrough text.
